title: 8.1.11 Project: Desk Tray
description: Put it all together: a box, hollowed into a tray, with one softened edge. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Add the box
steps.instructions: Press the Box tool. In the Dimensions panel, type 80 in width, 50 in depth, and 20 in height.
hints: This is the same first step as every box you've built this unit - just three different numbers.

steps.title: Hollow it into a tray
steps.instructions: Click the top face, then press Hollow. In the Dimensions panel, wall reads 2 - type 2.5, so the walls are 2.5 mm thick.
hints: A message under the 3D view should read "Hollow 1 is open at the top face." That's what makes it a tray instead of a sealed block.

steps.title: Drill a cable hole through the front
steps.instructions: Click the front face of the tray (the long wall facing you), then press the Hole tool. In the Dimensions panel, the diameter reads 6 - type 12. The hole goes straight through the front wall and the back wall, a gap for a charging cable.
hints: The label above the Dimensions panel should read "Box 1 · front face" before you press Hole. If it reads a hollow or top name, click the outside of the long wall again.
The new step shows up in the timeline as "Hole 1".
In the Code side the same step is one line: hole(b, { across: 12, along: 'y' }).

requirements.title: An 80 x 50 x 20 tray with 2.5 mm walls and a 12 mm hole
requirements.description: An 80 x 50 x 20 mm box, hollowed to 2.5 mm walls with the top open, with a 12 mm hole drilled through the front and back walls.
requirements.hint: Box 80 x 50 x 20, Hollow wall 2.5 open top, then click the front face and press Hole with diameter 12.
